fields.description: Sera 1 is a residential collection at Rashid Yachts & Marina, combining one to three bedroom apartments with three bedroom townhouses. Its setting brings landscaped water gardens and leisure terraces close to the marina promenade. The architecture uses sand-toned surfaces, reflective glazing and champagne-coloured accents.

overview: The Sera 1 brochure focuses on the water garden, shared pool and planted leisure areas, with the marina promenade a short walk away in the proposed setting. Yoga decks, a recreational lawn and an amphitheatre sit alongside the more active courts and children’s spaces. The distinction between the private home, shared podium facilities and wider marina attractions matters: a residence does not automatically include yacht-club membership or a berth.
research.locationNote: Sera 1 is within the Rashid Yachts & Marina masterplan at Mina Rashid. The official map shows its relationship to the waterfront promenade, canal pool and QE2 hotel, with Dubai’s heritage districts and wider road network nearby. Access routes and walking or driving times should be checked for the chosen home.
research.priceNote: The Sera 1 developer page advertises a starting price of AED 2.1 million. It is not an available-unit quotation. Current stock, floor, layout, price and purchase terms require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The Sera 1 launch schedule has 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Dates are historical launch milestones, some already passed; obtain the selected unit’s current payment statement.
research.handoverNote: November 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in the Sera 1 payment PDF, also reported by Property Finder. It is not a guarantee of delivery; the contract and current developer update should be checked.

facts.value: Mitchell’s dated registry report records 203 homes, with 96 assigned to Tower A and 107 to Tower B. It describes A as ground, podium and seven floors, and B as ground, podium and eight. This is a third-party registry account, not a direct live DLD check or availability count.

facts.label: Outdoor area affects totals
facts.value: Totals include balcony or terrace space. Building A unit 103 has a 1,414.38 sq ft suite and 635.50 sq ft terrace, totalling 2,049.88 sq ft. The townhouse plans show two levels, upstairs bedrooms and a separate maid’s room below.
